Cheese Cat-astrophe Starring Speedy Gonz.name: Cheese Cat-Astrophe starring Speedy Gonzales
Cheese Cat-astrophe Starring Speedy Gonz.summary: Sylvester's alter ego, the dastardly Dr. Cheesefinger, has "kidnapped" the cheese supply and Speedy Gonzales' girlfriend, Carmel. Can this "speedy-mouse" outwit the callous cat and rescue the village cheese supply?

Line of Fire.name: Line of Fire
Line of Fire.summary: Just as you stole the enemy's secret weapon and started back, the enemy spotted you! Now you must fight your way back to safety. But be careful! You're in the line of fire.

Super Space Invaders.name: Super Space Invaders
Super Space Invaders.summary: Space Invaders is the most famous video game ever! Now SUPER SPACE INVADERS has arrived with a host of amazing new features - wave after wave of weird and hostile aliens, fantastic multiway scrolling playfields, huge end of level mega monsters and secret levels for only the best to find! It'll drive you crazy, but you won't be able to leave it alone!
